notGrantedUntil: the user explicitly confirms the G33 user-visible goal and this budget; until then G33 stays not_started and no cargo/CLI/browser/aux/product process may run
principles: Resources must not be squeezed so tightly that the required evidence cannot be produced (handoff section 6).
cargo must include at least one formal build chain plus one repair margin.
CLI must include at least export + audit; add one more export when determinism is a hard requirement.
browser must retain at least one formal re-measurement margin.
aux must contain room for fixture self-check plus the formal session, to avoid burning the allowance on a parameter/timing mistake.
Any overspend is itemised separately and never offset by historical balance; it is never legalised after the fact.
One well-targeted re-test is allowed; endless tuning to green is forbidden.

cargo.rationale: one formal build chain (test + build, since the viewer enters the exe via include_str!) plus one repair margin

cli.rationale: export + audit, plus one determinism export (the package seal and the six-file reproducibility check)

browser.rationale: at least one formal re-measurement margin; a visual/intent increment needs a default and a target-state session

aux.rationale: fixture self-check + static preflight + one formal session, with a safety margin so a parameter/timing slip does not exhaust the allowance

archiveMiB.rationale: matches the G32 round envelope and is well above the ~1.7 MiB of a driver-only round, leaving room for screenshots and records

historyNotReset.note: these are historical facts reported by each round's own report/ledger; they are preserved as-is and are neither ratified, offset nor reset by this proposal

g32r2c1.note: this C1 round itself stayed inside its allowance; its dry-run probes that launched Chrome inside a scratch root are disclosed in budget.json, not absorbed

g31r1.note: also carries the pre-existing missing build-archive.cjs gap

nextStepAfterGrant: write the G33 implementation task book (phase B: product contract, visual intent, byte backups, baseline hashes, product allowlist, invariants/counter-examples, new evidence directory)
